items.headline: Founder & CEO, The PEP Institute | Passionate About Human Potential, Self-Perception & Helping People Live, Work and Lead in Greater Alignment | Building Human Alignment for the AI Era | Author, Consultant & Speaker
items.about:
I help people, leaders, teams, and organizations see what’s operating beneath their decisions, communication, relationships, leadership, production, and results — so they can move with greater alignment, coherence, and excellence.

I’m the Founder & CEO of The PEP Institute™, a transformational wisdom-tech company building Human Alignment for the AI Era™ and perception infrastructure for modern leadership.

My work is rooted in one central premise:

When self-perception is distorted, every decision downstream inherits the distortion.

For decades, I’ve helped people return to accurate self-perception — as a practical foundation for clearer decisions, stronger communication, deeper trust, aligned action, and sustainable excellence.

Today, that work has evolved into Human Alignment: the coherent operation of identity, perception, values, human abilities, decisions, and actions in service of what we consciously intend to create, contribute, and accomplish.

In organizations, Human Alignment is the human operating layer beneath leadership, decision quality, communication, execution, and change.

My multidimensional career — from international model to author, executive coach, speaker, and master lifestyle strategist — gave me firsthand insight into image, identity, visibility, perception, and the cost of being seen without being fully known.

Through The PEP Institute™, I created/co-created the Personal Excellence Profile™ Diagnostic — a current-state diagnostic mirror that reveals what is operating now across 12 Human Abilities, including strengths, blind spots, patterns, and forward movement.

It is not a personality test. It reveals what traditional metrics, titles, resumes, and outward results often cannot show.

As AI accelerates intelligence and output, organizations need stronger human infrastructure — perception, discernment, decision quality, communication, trust, purpose, and aligned action.

AI can increase intelligence. It cannot create Human Alignment.

I work with leaders and organizations navigating AI transformation, leadership transition, succession, reorganization, role redesign, and other moments of accelerated change.

Speaking + organizational topics:
Human Alignment for the AI Era™
Perception Infrastructure for Modern Leadership
The Hidden Layer of Leadership
The Human Being Is Still the Original Technology
Executive Alignment™
HR 3.0 and the Wisdom Economy

The work is not simply about becoming more visible.

It’s about seeing more accurately, aligning more coherently, and becoming more precisely human.

currentPosition.description:
Founder & CEO | The PEP Institute: Perception Infrastructure for Modern Leadership

I founded The PEP Institute on a premise most leadership development has been unwilling to name: the primary obstacle to executive performance is not skill, strategy, or will — it is perception.

That gap has a name. Identity incoherence. And it is the most under-diagnosed variable in organizational failure today.

The PEP Institute closes that gap through the Personal Excellence Profile™ — a proprietary diagnostic framework mapping identity coherence across 8 energetic zones and 12 core Life Abilities. Not a personality test. Not a competency checklist. A structural diagnostic that reveals where perception has drifted from reality — and what that drift is costing.

I work with Fortune 100 executives, CHROs, and transformation leaders to build perception infrastructure at the individual and organizational level. Marvin Ellison, Fortune 100 CEO, has experienced the work firsthand. So have the senior leaders inside some of the world's most complex organizations.

This is not coaching in the traditional sense. It is structural recalibration — the diagnostic layer that should exist beneath every leadership strategy, every culture initiative, every succession plan.

I built it because it didn't exist. I named it because no one else had. And I deployed it as Software as a Sacred Service — because rigorous diagnostic technology and human wisdom were never in conflict. They are the same offering.

Current focus: Scaling enterprise licensing · Expanding PEP Coach Certification · Advancing perception infrastructure as the defining leadership conversation of this decade.

The PEP Institute — because you cannot lead clearly from a distorted view of yourself.

items.about:
What happens when AI moves beyond the screen and begins to speak, respond, and occupy the same space as us?

My work examines how the form AI takes, from text and voice to embodied agents in mixed reality, shapes what people learn, perceive, trust, and experience.

I am a higher education faculty member and researcher working at the intersection of human-centered AI, multimodal embodied conversational AI, XR, and learning. I earned my Ed.D. in Instructional Technology and Media from Teachers College, Columbia University, where my research examined multimodal conversational AI and embodied agents.

At Media University of Applied Sciences in Berlin, I teach conversational AI, chatbot design, embodied AI, responsible AI, and the EU AI Act in the AI & Society program. I also teach Computational Thinking as an Adjunct Assistant Professor at the College of Staten Island, CUNY. Previously, at New York Institute of Technology, I taught HCI, UX research, usability testing, and UX design for XR.

My research asks: can the same AI produce different human experiences and outcomes depending on how we encounter it? I study voice and embodied AI in mixed reality, as well as anthropomorphism and how people describe, perceive, and relate to AI.

• Founder of the Intelligent Reality in Education Association at Teachers College, Columbia University
• Award-winning designer of MindFlow AI, a VR yoga app recognized as Most Engaging App
• Recipient of an AI innovation grant for integrating AI into teaching
• Bestselling co-author on artificial intelligence

My forthcoming book, Intelligent Realities, develops an idea central to my research: AI does not independently create a single reality for us. What emerges through human-AI interaction is shaped by human agency, context, system behavior, interface design, modality, culture, and how people interpret AI. As AI becomes more embodied and humanlike, anthropomorphism, presence, trust, and influence become increasingly important.

I collaborate with universities, researchers, educational organizations, and technology teams on human-centered AI, embodied conversational AI, XR learning, responsible AI, and intelligent learning experiences.

Specialties: Human-Centered AI, Embodied Conversational AI, Human-AI Interaction, Anthropomorphism, XR, AI for Language Learning, Responsible AI, UX Research, Intelligent Learning Environments

items.about:
For more than thirty years, I have operated on one conviction. Alignment before opportunity. Most people evaluate the business first. I evaluate the person making the decision first, because the wrong person in the right opportunity still produces the wrong outcome.

I learned that discipline in the United States Navy, where lasting results came from preparation, accountability, and showing up long after the excitement faded. I learned it again, more expensively, early in my career, when I sold a business relationship to someone who was excited about the opportunity but was never truly aligned with what owning it would require of him. The deal fell apart before it ever became a business. That lesson shaped everything I have built since.

I have spent three decades testing that belief inside my own companies before teaching it to anyone else. Convenience Services Group and ReFresh Facility Services, both based in Northwest Indiana, are not case studies I studied from the outside. They are the proving ground where every framework I now teach was built, broken, rebuilt, and proven.

That proving ground is why I built ELEV8 Growth Systems™, which installs the same growth infrastructure inside other companies that I use in my own, and why I founded Legacy Navigator™, an advisory platform built entirely around the Ownership Decision Framework™ and the belief that alignment must come before opportunity.
Helping entrepreneurs make that evaluation honestly led to something larger than consulting. Writing.

I founded Keel & Rudder™, the publishing house behind The Decision Series™, a six book series exploring the decisions that shape ownership, leadership, and legacy. Book one, UNFINISHED, launches October 6, 2026. Book three, The Second Oath, speaks directly to veterans and first responders navigating the same ownership decisions I once faced myself.

Different audiences, one conviction. Businesses do not transform lives. People do. Businesses are simply one of the greatest vehicles for creating opportunity, developing leaders, and building something that outlives you.

experience.position: Founder, ELEV8 Growth Systems™ | Helping Leaders Build Better Businesses
experience.description:
I built ELEV8 Growth Systems™ to help leaders build better businesses.

Before ELEV8 existed as anything other than an idea, I built its systems inside my own companies. Convenience Services Group and ReFresh Facility Services are not case studies I studied from the outside. They are the proving ground where every piece of this was tested, broken, rebuilt, and proven before I ever offered it to anyone else.

Growth does not usually fail because of effort. It fails because the systems underneath the effort are unclear, fragmented, or unable to support demand as it increases. I built ELEV8 to fix that, starting with the two companies I run every day.

ELEV8 designs and installs the growth-centered operating systems that let service-based and franchise businesses run without the owner as the bottleneck, spanning:

* CRM and lead management
* Business phone and email infrastructure
* Demand generation and inbound systems
* Financial visibility and payroll infrastructure, through trusted partners like Relay and Xero
* Team coordination and delegation systems

These systems are built to live inside the organization and compound over time, not to depend on an outside agency to keep running.

I work with owners across the trades and service industries, home services, commercial cleaning, vending, retail, and franchise or multi-location operations alike, the same category of company I have operated for more than thirty years myself.

My approach is simple. Growth should be engineered, not improvised. ELEV8 exists to build the systems that make that possible, proven first on my own companies, then shared with others who are trying to build the same thing.

I founded Legacy Navigator™ as a growth advisory platform built on one belief I learned the expensive way, long before I ever taught it to anyone else: alignment before opportunity.

Early in my career, I sold a business relationship to someone who was excited about the opportunity but was never truly aligned with what owning it would require of them. The deal fell apart before it ever became a business. That lesson has shaped every decision I have made since, and it is the reason Legacy Navigator exists.

Most advisors evaluate the opportunity first and the person second. I do the opposite. Before I ever help someone evaluate a business or a growth path, I help them evaluate themselves, because the wrong person in the right opportunity still produces the wrong outcome.

Through the Ownership Decision Framework™, I guide entrepreneurs through a structured process built around personal alignment, financial readiness, business fit, operational role, and timing, whether they are acquiring a business, stepping into a larger ownership role, or positioning an existing company for its next stage of growth.
Because growing the wrong way well is still the wrong decision.

Legacy Navigator also connects clients with capital resources, strategic partners, and carefully selected opportunities chosen to support long-term, sustainable growth rather than short-term excitement. Through our Capital Network™, we help any business owner, regardless of industry or size, find the funding they actually need, from personal and business credit building to full funding placement, backed by a network of hundreds of lenders and funding partners rather than a single source.

Leadership Principle: The best growth decision is rarely the most exciting one. It is the one aligned with the person making it.

Whether it’s résumé reviews, interview preparation, career exploration, or small business development, each mentorship is tailored to the unique goals of the Protégé. We work together to tackle:

✔ Career transitions and advancement
✔ Building professional networks
✔ Achieving work-life balance
✔ Leadership and communication skills

ACP’s structured, yearlong program ensures mentorships are impactful and well-supported. With the guidance of ACP staff and monthly discussions, we chart a clear path toward achieving the Protégé’s ambitions.

Being part of this process is deeply rewarding. It’s not just about helping others—it’s about giving back to the veteran community and helping fellow service members and their families build lives they don’t need a vacation from.

To my fellow veterans: if you’re looking for guidance on your career journey, I highly recommend connecting with ACP. To those in the corporate world, consider becoming a Mentor—you’ll find it as fulfilling as I do.
